transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess... my head just doesn't stay on task anymore. Um. Like at work, I'll be doing inventory or head to the supply closet and just... forget what I went in there for. Or if I try studying for the supervisor certification, I just keep reading the same line over and over. So... yeah. That's why I came in.
Do you have trouble paying attention to things you're doing or listening when someone is talking to you?

Yeah... like I was just saying. It's just hard to stay focused on what I'm doing. The inventory, or trying to read... it just slips away. And... yeah, I guess sometimes I drift off when people are talking to me, too. I just kind of... zone out.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?
No... not really. I don't think I do that. I mostly just... sit there, I guess.
{"intent": "determine presence of hyperactivity", "question": "Do you often feel like you're "on the go" or like you can't slow down?"}
No. Um... not really. I don't feel like that. It's more like I just... can't get going in the first place.
Have you been feeling sad, empty, or hopeless lately?

Yeah... I guess so. It's mostly just... I don't know, this flat feeling. Just heavy. 

It kind of follows me around most days. Even when I'm just at work, pushing my cart down an empty hall... or sitting with my family. I just... try to act normal, I guess. But it's there.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like?
I don't know. Um... I don't really do much these days anyway. Just... work and go home. So, I'm not really sure.
Do you feel like you're not getting pleasure from things that normally would be enjoyable to you?
I mean... I'm not really sure. Like I just said, I don't do a whole lot besides my shifts at the building. So I haven't really noticed if things are enjoyable or not. I just... get through the day.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but now you don't enjoy them as much?
I... I really don't know what else to tell you. I don't have a list of hobbies or... things I used to do. It's just work and home. I can't really think of anything.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?
Um... no, not really. My clothes still fit the same, I guess. I haven't really been paying attention.
Do you feel like you're not getting pleasure from things that normally would be enjoyable to you, like being with your family?
I don't... I don't really see them much. Like I was saying, it's mostly just work and going back to my place. So... I don't really know. It's just fine, I guess.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that would normally bring you happiness?
I mean... I don't know. Like I said, I don't really do much anyway. It's just... I just go to work and come home. So, I don't know about happiness or whatever. It's just... the same.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that would normally bring you happiness, such as eating your favorite food?
I mean... food is just food. I just eat whatever's easy to make. I don't really pay attention to if it makes me happy or not... it's just eating.
Do you often feel guilty about things?
I don't... I don't really think so. Not really. I just... I just do my job and try to stay out of the way. There's not much to feel guilty about, I guess.
Have you noticed a decrease in interest in activities you used to find enjoyable?
I don't know. Like I said, I don't really do much. I just... I don't really have hobbies or anything. So I haven't really noticed a difference.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that would normally bring you happiness, like being around friends?
I don't really... I mean, I don't see a lot of people outside of work. I just clean the building and go home. So... I don't know. I don't really hang around friends enough to tell you.
Have you had a period of two weeks or more where you felt sad or empty nearly every day?

I guess... yeah. Most days, really. It's just... this heavy, flat feeling. It kind of just follows me around. Even when I'm just pushing the cart down an empty hallway at work, or... or sitting with my family, trying to act normal. It's just always there.
Have you noticed a lack of interest in activities that you used to find pleasurable?
I... I think you just asked me that. Like I said before, I don't really have things I do for fun anyway. So, no, not really.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that would normally bring you happiness, such as watching a movie or playing a game?
I don't really... watch movies or anything. I usually just go home and go to bed. So... I don't know. I couldn't tell you.
Has this flat feeling or your trouble focusing been causing problems for you at work or in your daily life?

I mean... I still get the cleaning done. It just takes me longer. I... I second-guess my logs a lot. I guess it's why I stopped trying to get on the supervisor track. And... I don't know, I've been skipping the neighborhood clean-ups and family get-togethers I used to go to. So... maybe a little.
Have you been having any physical symptoms like headaches or stomachaches lately?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... maybe just the usual soreness from work, but... no headaches or stomachaches. Nothing like that.
